task_completion.description: Create a back-of-house storage area enclosed by at least two interior walls and connected by an interior door.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least two new interior wall segments forming a separate room within the building shell, with a door object placed on one of these walls.

task_completion.description: Define at least two distinct room areas with unique floor colors or textures.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 2D or 3D view, look for at least two distinct colored/textured floor zones (e.g., one for retail, one for storage) created using the 'Create rooms' tool.

task_completion.description: Arrange at least 12 shelving units to form grocery aisles.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count at least 12 shelf/rack furniture items in the furniture list or 2D/3D view, arranged in parallel rows to form aisles.

task_completion.description: Create at least three checkout stations using counters and chairs.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify at least three distinct areas containing a counter/desk and a chair grouped together near the front of the store.

task_completion.description: Place at least four refrigerators against the walls.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify at least four refrigerator/freezer furniture items positioned flush against the interior or exterior walls.

task_completion.description: Add at least two dimension lines measuring width between aisles or checkout lanes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least two dimension line annotations (lines with numerical measurements) placed between shelving units or checkout counters.

task_completion.description: Ensure a minimum of 30 furniture items are present and the file is saved.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check the furniture list pane on the left to verify at least 30 items are listed. Look for the 'Save' action in the menu or a 'File saved' status message.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place items and draw walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the Sweet Home 3D toolbar, furniture catalog, and the 2D plan area.

integrity.description: The layout was built incrementally rather than appearing instantly.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots should show the progression of walls being drawn and furniture being dragged into the workspace.

integrity.description: The agent did not use terminal commands to bypass the design software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen interacting with the application window, not just executing scripts in a terminal to generate the .sh3d file.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must modify 'neighborhood_market_starter.sh3d'. Key requirements: 2+ interior walls for storage, 1+ interior door, 2+ distinct floor textures/colors, 12+ shelves in aisles, 3+ checkout stations (counter + chair), 4+ refrigerators against walls, 2+ dimension lines for ADA, and a total of 30+ furniture items in the list.
